Title 3—The President
Executive Order 12083 . September 27, 1978
Energy Coordinating Committee
By the authority vested in me as President by the Constitution of the  
United States of America, and in order to provide for the coordination of  
Federal energy policies, it is hereby ordered as follows:
1-1. Establishment of the Committee.
1-101. There is established an Energy Coordinating Committee, herein­
after referred to as the Committee.
1-102. The Committee shall be composed of the following, and such  
other members as the President may, from time to time, designate.
The Secretary of Energy, who shall be the Chairman.

(c) The Secretary of the Treasury.
(d) The Secretary of Defense.
(e) The Attorney General.

(g) The Secretary of Agriculture,
